Power 
 Station

Technical 
 Procedure
Equipment:

SF6 Circuit Breaker 500kv
 HPL- 500 T 31 - A4
 ABB
Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed every (4 times / years) bases as 
indicated by manufacturer title block

The technical 
specification of the circuit breaker : rated current = 2000A, and rated voltage 
= 500 kv short-circuit current = 40 kA

The first draft initiated and tested by eng. Soleiman Abd El Fattah Soleiman at High Dam 
Power Station , accepted by eng. Badr Ibrahem Abdel Gawad: general director, 
approved by eng. Abdel Karem Abu Zaid: High Dam head Sector, and certified by 
eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakeem: EPGC quality control general director, MPIS 
Coordinator.
Safety Precautions

items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintanance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety equipment as helmet, shoes
Switch off the CB and grounded its sides
Switch off DC & AC supply control

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Portable air blower, metal brush
Set of common screw drivers, and cleaning material (rag, cloth)
Water pump

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Inspect visually the 
condition of the breaker together with a check of the gas pressure, insulators, 
operating mechanism and heating elements

Check air compressor 
lubricant level

Check air compressor for 
lubricant leaks

Wash air compressor inlet 
filter sleeve

Wash all housing air 
filters: main control, phase and compressor

Check air compressor belt 
tension

Drain condensation for air 
tank

Replace inner filter on 
air compressor inlet if holes or tears develop

Clean all parts of the 
compressor

Change air compressor 
lubricant and filter

Perform the test of (start 
- stop) operations of compressors
Clean the insulators of CB
